outputs.explanation: Panel A shows fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge), not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel B includes bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing group means with error bars but no overlaid individual data points, despite n=20 replicates being available.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D contains bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity (means with error bars, N indicated in bars) but does not show the individual data points underlying these averages.
Panel E shows FACS histograms (cell counts vs TMRM intensity) which are raw distribution plots, not bar charts of averaged summary statistics, so individual data point overlay is not applicable.
